split_points =: 3 : 0

break_text =: 3 : 0
    'metrics method costs' =. y
    finish =. (#0{::metrics)-1
    positions =. i.0
    if. method-:'greedy' do.
        start =. 0
        previous_class =. 1
        total =. 0
        while. start<finish do.
            chosen =. start+1
            if. 0<:metrics slack start,chosen do.
                for_end. (chosen+1)+i.finish-chosen do.
                    if. 0>metrics slack start,end do.
                        break.
                    end.
                    chosen =. end
                end.
            end.
            total =. total+metrics line_cost (<start),(<chosen),(<previous_class),<costs
            previous_class =. line_class (metrics slack start,chosen),chosen=finish
            positions =. positions,chosen
            start =. chosen
        end.
        (<positions),<total return.
    end.
    totals =. ((finish+1),4)$_1
    previous =. ($totals)$_1
    classes =. ($totals)$_1
    totals =. 0 (<0,1)}totals
    for_end. 1+i.finish do.
        for_start. |.i.end do.
            space =. metrics slack start,end
            if. (space<0)*.end~:start+1 do.
                break.
            end.
            current_class =. line_class space,end=finish
            for_previous_class. i.4 do.
                before =. (<start,previous_class){totals
                if. before<0 do.
                    continue.
                end.
                cost =. before+metrics line_cost (<start),(<end),(<previous_class),<costs
                coordinate =. <end,current_class
                best =. coordinate{totals
                take =. (best<0)+.cost<best
                if. cost=best do.
                    take =. (start<coordinate{previous)+.((start=coordinate{previous)*.previous_class<coordinate{classes)
                end.
                if. take do.
                    totals =. cost coordinate}totals
                    previous =. start coordinate}previous
                    classes =. previous_class coordinate}classes
                end.
            end.
        end.
    end.
    position =. finish
    current_class =. 1
    total =. (<position,current_class){totals
    while. position>0 do.
        positions =. positions,position
        coordinate =. <position,current_class
        position =. coordinate{previous
        current_class =. coordinate{classes
    end.
    (<|.positions),<total
)

choose_pages =: 3 : 0
    'blocks footnote_heights height orphan widow' =. y
    lines =. 0$a:
    boundaries =. 0 3$0
    for_index. i.#blocks do.
        'kind content list_mark page_break' =. index{::blocks
        start =. #lines
        lines =. lines,content
        count =. #content
        if. kind-:'flow' do.
            for_kept. 1+i.count-1 do.
                if. (kept>:orphan)*.(count-kept)>:widow do.
                    boundaries =. boundaries,(start+kept),(start+kept),0
                end.
            end.
        end.
        if. index=(#blocks)-1 do.
            boundaries =. boundaries,(#lines),(#lines),1
        else.
            following =. (index+1){::blocks
            end =. #lines
            if. -.list_mark*.2{::following do.
                lines =. lines,<new_line ''
            end.
            forced =. 3{::following
            if. forced+.-.kind-:'heading' do.
                boundaries =. boundaries,end,(#lines),forced
            end.
        end.
    end.
    pages =. 0$a:
    start =. 0
    first_boundary =. 0
    while. start<#lines do.
        notes =. (#footnote_heights)$0
        note_height =. 0
        scanned =. start
        chosen =. _1
        used =. 0
        chosen_notes =. i.0
        for_index. first_boundary+i.(#boundaries)-first_boundary do.
            'end next_start forced' =. index{boundaries
            while. scanned<end do.
                for_number. 1{::scanned{::lines do.
                    if. -.number{notes do.
                        notes =. 1 number}notes
                        note_height =. note_height+number{footnote_heights
                    end.
                end.
                scanned =. scanned+1
            end.
            page_notes =. I.notes
            current_height =. ((end-start)+note_height)+0<#page_notes
            if. current_height>height do.
                break.
            end.
            chosen =. index
            used =. current_height
            chosen_notes =. page_notes
            if. forced do.
                break.
            end.
        end.
        'end next_start forced' =. chosen{boundaries
        content =. (start+i.end-start){lines
        pages =. pages,<new_page (<content),(<chosen_notes),(<used),<forced
        start =. next_start
        first_boundary =. chosen+1
    end.
    pages
)

literal_replace =: 4 : 0
    'pattern replacement' =. y
    result =. ''
    position =. 0
    width =. #pattern
    while. position<#x do.
        if. pattern-:width{.position}.x do.
            result =. result,replacement
            position =. position+width
        else.
            result =. result,position{x
            position =. position+1
        end.
    end.
    result
)

display_line =: 3 : 0
    'pieces slack alignment last' =. y
    displayed =. 0$a:
    for_box. pieces do.
        piece =. >box
        displayed =. displayed,<' '(I.piece='~')}piece
    end.
    text =. ' 'join displayed
    if. slack<:0 do.
        text return.
    end.
    gaps =. (#displayed)-1
    if. ((alignment-:'justify')*.-.last)*.gaps>0 do.
        text =. 0{::displayed
        for_index. 1+i.(#displayed)-1 do.
            spaces =. ((slack intdiv gaps)+1)+(index-1)<gaps|slack
            text =. text,(spaces#' '),index{::displayed
        end.
        text return.
    elseif. alignment-:'right' do.
        (slack#' '),text
    elseif. alignment-:'center' do.
        ((slack intdiv 2)#' '),text
    else.
        text
    end.
)
format_table =: 3 : 0
    'rows columns caption number' =. y
    widths =. (#columns)$0
    for_box. rows do.
        row =. >box
        widths =. widths>.#&>row
    end.
    lines =. 0$a:
    if. #caption do.
        lines =. lines,<'Table ',number,'. ',caption
    end.
    for_row_index. i.#rows do.
        row =. row_index{::rows
        cells =. 0$a:
        for_index. i.#columns do.
            text =. index{::row
            missing =. (index{widths)-#text
            alignment =. index{columns
            if. alignment='l' do.
                cell =. text,missing#' '
            elseif. alignment='r' do.
                cell =. (missing#' '),text
            else.
                before =. missing intdiv 2
                cell =. (before#' '),text,(missing-before)#' '
            end.
            cells =. cells,<cell
        end.
        lines =. lines,<trim_right ' | 'join cells
        if. row_index=0 do.
            rules =. 0$a:
            for_width. widths do.
                rules =. rules,<width#'-'
            end.
            lines =. lines,<'-+-'join rules
        end.
    end.
    lines
)
